description: Results paragraph writer / 结果段落生成 | USE WHEN: the user has statistical results and wants them written into a results paragraph | ALIASES: 结果段落, 写结果, 结果描述, results paragraph, write up the results | RETURNS: 结果段落

design_type.description: 研究设计，取值 rct | cohort | case_control | cross_sectional | diagnostic | meta_analysis（缺省按 params 自动识别）

group_variable.description: 分组变量列名（结果按此分组表述）。

include_checklist.description: 是否附报告规范条目核对清单，默认 false。

include_methods.description: 是否同时输出统计方法段，默认 false。

lang.description: zh | en，默认 zh（en 时输出英文段落）

model_type.description: 设计推断用模型：logistic | cox，默认 logistic

params.description: 统计结果载荷：table_one / univariable / multivariable / subgroup / roc 等；不传给不出结果段

polish_level.description: 润色档位：conservative | standard | enhanced | top_journal

polish_results.description: 是否对结果段做语言润色，默认 false。

name: results_paragraph_writer
title: Results paragraph writer / 结果段落生成
